subject.title: fix(compaction): emit after_compaction on no-op and use JSON-safe validator delimiters (#81925)

question: Should successful no-op `after_compaction` events expose the proposed optional `reason` string as a stable Plugin SDK contract, and which values may plugin authors rely on?
rationale: Event pairing fixes established behavior, but Codex does not define this discriminator and the shared external payload must be intentional and consistent across embedded, Codex, and Copilot runtimes.

options.title: Document stable reasons
options.body: Keep the additive field, define its stable semantics and values, and align all runtime producers before merge.

options.title: Use count only
options.body: Emit paired completion with `compactedCount: 0` and remove the new public discriminator.

options.title: Define typed outcome
options.body: Replace the free-form string with a closed cross-runtime completion outcome contract.

recommendation.title: Document stable reasons
recommendation.body: Keep the additive field, define its stable semantics and values, and align all runtime producers before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent protocol, Plugin SDK boundary, Codex binding, and compaction-runtime history makes this the strongest available owner for the shared contract choice.
